workItemReview.finding: Automatic context is capped at 900 tokens; runtime intake at 6000 characters; semantic carry-over at 8000 characters; aggregate text compacts above 12000 characters or 180 lines into bounded private captures. Resume injects no duplicate intake/context pack and the provider-visible tool schema remains stable.

One immutable post-event observation is shared by mutation, verifier, authorship, review, repair and changed-file consumers. Every configured verifier requires its latest stable pre == post == current digest; unavailable evidence cannot prove completion.

Task Contract, journal, trajectory and handoff reconstruct bounded task, plan, progress, exact verifier state and one next action across a fresh process. Torn tails, corruption, disk failure, stale evidence and retry exhaustion remain fail-closed.

The 566-file package contains the complete production import graph and no private state. A disposable macOS prefix installs v1.2.17, upgrades to the exact current source package, and rolls back to v1.2.17 without changing synthetic operator credential, trust or session bytes/modes.
